blocks.text: Grade 5 高频词汇 801–900
avocado /.ævəu'kɑːdou/ n. 鳄梨, 鳄梨树
They help produce foods like apples, watermelon, peppers, broccoli, peaches, berries, avocados, and even almonds.
中文语境：它们有助于生产苹果、西瓜、辣椒、西兰花、桃子、浆果、鳄梨，甚至杏仁等食物
dose /dəus/ n. 剂量, 服用量；v.t. 给药, (用药)医治；v.i. 服药
Scientists are figuring out how to replace harmful pesticides with more bee-friendly chemicals and how to spray pesticides in smaller doses, so that pesticides do not kill bees or the food they eat.
中文语境：科学家们正在研究如何用对蜜蜂更友好的化学物质取代有害的农药，以及如何以较小的剂量喷洒农药，这样农药就不会杀死蜜蜂或它们吃的食物
cultivate /'kʌltiveit/ v.t. 培养, 耕作
Additionally, beekeepers and scientists encourage people to cultivate habitats that are healthy for bees.
中文语境：此外，养蜂人和科学家鼓励人们培育对蜜蜂健康的栖息地
produce /prə'djuːs/ n. 生产品, 物产, 后代；v.t. 产生, 生产, 提出, 出示；v.i. 生产, 制造
They help produce foods like apples, watermelon, peppers, broccoli, peaches, berries, avocados, and even almonds.
中文语境：它们有助于生产苹果、西瓜、辣椒、西兰花、桃子、浆果、鳄梨，甚至杏仁等食物
fauna /'fɒːnə/ n. 动物群；[医] 动物区系
As poaching of Asia's tigers got out of control, CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora) banned the trade of tiger parts in 1987.
中文语境：随着亚洲虎偷猎失控，CITES（濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约）于1987年禁止老虎器官贸易
ulcer /'ʌlsə/ n. 溃疡, 腐烂物；[医] 溃疡

For thousands of years, traditional Chinese medicine has depended on tiger parts from across Asia to treat illnesses: people believed noses treated epilepsy, tiger bones healed ulcers, tiger tails cured skin diseases, and tiger whiskers soothed toothaches.
中文语境：几千年来，传统中医一直依靠亚洲各地的虎部位来治疗疾病：人们相信鼻子可以治疗癫痫，虎骨可以治疗溃疡，虎尾可以治疗皮肤病，虎须可以缓解牙痛
flora /'flɒːrə/ n. 植物群；[医] 植物区系, 植物丛, 植物群, 菌丛
As poaching of Asia's tigers got out of control, CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora) banned the trade of tiger parts in 1987.
中文语境：随着亚洲虎偷猎失控，CITES（濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约）于1987年禁止老虎器官贸易
flaunt /flaunt/ n. 炫耀, 飘扬；v. 炫耀, 飘扬
Think of displaying a skinned tiger like flaunting a fancy sports car.
中文语境：想象一下展示一只被剥皮的老虎就像炫耀一辆豪华跑车一样
irresistible /.iri'zistəbl/ adj. 不可抵抗的, 不能压制的；[经] 不可抗力
Although snuggling a tiger cub sounds irresistible, tourists' money fuels tigers' captivity.
中文语境：尽管依偎着一只小虎听起来令人难以抗拒，但游客的金钱却助长了老虎的圈养
ambitious /æm'biʃəs/ adj. 有野心的, 抱负不凡的, 雄心勃勃的
Although countries did not reach this ambitious goal, the future looks hopeful for tigers.
中文语境：尽管各国没有实现这一雄心勃勃的目标，但老虎的未来充满希望
albatross /'ælbətrɒs/ n. 信天翁, 沉重负担
Plastics also kill up to a million seabirds each year, including the Laysan Albatross.
中文语境：塑料每年还会杀死多达一百万只海鸟，其中包括莱桑信天翁
biodegradable /.baiəudi'greidəbl/ adj. 能进行生物降解的
Plastics are not biodegradable, meaning they do not decompose.
中文语境：塑料不可生物降解，这意味着它们不会分解
uncontaminated /'ʌnkən'tæmineitid/ adj. 没有被污染的, 未沾染的
Milkers follow strict procedures when extracting venom so that the poison stays uncontaminated and so that the milker stays safe.
中文语境：挤奶工在提取毒液时遵循严格的程序，以确保毒物不被污染，从而确保挤奶工的安全
methodical /mi'θɒdikl/ adj. 有方法的, 有系统的
Venom milkers tend to be curious, methodical, and adventurous.
中文语境：毒液挤奶工往往充满好奇心、有条理且富有冒险精神
contiguous /kən'tigjuəs/ adj. 邻近的, 接近的；[医] 接触的
According to National Geographic , between 1,400 and 1,700 grizzly bears now inhabit the contiguous United States.
中文语境：据《国家地理》报道，目前美国本土栖息着 1,400 至 1,700 只灰熊
demonstration /.demən'streiʃən/ n. 示范, 实证；[医] 示教, 实物教授
In addition, zoo trainers feed and exercise animals, clean their habitats, keep records of their behavior, and lead animal demonstrations to educate visitors.
中文语境：此外，动物园训练员喂养和锻炼动物，清洁它们的栖息地，记录它们的行为，并进行动物演示以教育游客
glacial /'gleiʃəl/ adj. 冰的, 冰川的, 冰川时代的, 冰冷的；[医] 冰的, 冰样的
Measuring water temperatures and glacial melting costs scientists lots of time and money.
中文语境：测量水温和冰川融化花费了科学家大量的时间和金钱
dietary /'daiətəri/ adj. 饮食的；n. 规定食物
Scientists hypothesize that this dietary shift is a result of climate change.
中文语境：科学家推测这种饮食变化是气候变化的结果
perennial /pə'reniəl/ adj. 常年的, 长期的, 反复的；[医] 多年生的
Over the last 25 years, Baffin Bay's perennial ice (ice that remains all year and never melts) shrunk by 9% each decade, according to Science Buzz .
中文语境：据《Science Buzz》报道，在过去 25 年里，巴芬湾的常年冰（常年存在且永不融化的冰）每十年缩小 9%
unexplored /'ʌniks'plɔːd/ adj. 未勘查过的
For others, the desire propelling humans into space is simply one to push our limits and explore the unexplored of the cosmos.
中文语境：对于其他人来说，推动人类进入太空的愿望只是突破我们的极限并探索宇宙的未知领域
cosmos /'kɔzmɔs/ n. 宇宙, 秩序, 和谐, 大波斯菊；[医] 大波斯菊
For others, the desire propelling humans into space is simply one to push our limits and explore the unexplored of the cosmos.
中文语境：对于其他人来说，推动人类进入太空的愿望只是突破我们的极限并探索宇宙的未知领域
density /'densiti/ n. 密度；[化] 密度
Our muscles would deteriorate and our bone density would decrease from this lighter gravity.
中文语境：由于重力较轻，我们的肌肉会退化，骨密度也会降低
buffet /'bʌfit/ n. 自助餐, 小卖部, 碗橱, 殴打, 冲击；v.t. 连续打, 冲击, 搏斗；v.i. 奋斗
Their Australian home is like an all-you-can-eat buffet.
中文语境：他们的澳大利亚之家就像是自助餐
wreak /riːk/ v.t. 发泄(怒火), 报仇；[法] 报仇, 报复, 施
But the cane toad's superpower - or defense mechanism in biological terms - has wreaked havoc in northern Australia.
中文语境：但甘蔗蟾蜍的超能力--或者生物学意义上的防御机制--已经在澳大利亚北部造成了严重破坏
momentarily /'məuməntərili/ adv. 暂时地, 立刻, 随时地
The predators got momentarily sick - kind of like food poisoning - but built up immunity to the toad's toxin and learned to avoid eating adult toads which are the most powerful poisoners.
中文语境：捕食者暂时生病了--有点像食物中毒--但增强了对蟾蜍毒素的免疫力，并学会了避免吃成年蟾蜍，这是最强大的毒物
skyrocket /'skai.rɒkit/ v.i. 飞涨, 突升；n. 焰火
Without the jaguar, the number of armadillos would skyrocket.
中文语境：如果没有美洲虎，犰狳的数量将会猛增
corridor /'kɒridɒː/ n. 走廊, 回廊, 人口密集地带
Conservationists are working to create a "jaguar corridor," or a passageway for jaguars across 18 Latin American countries.
中文语境：自然资源保护主义者正在努力创建一条"美洲虎走廊"，即横跨 18 个拉丁美洲国家的美洲虎通道
flourish /'flʌriʃ/ v.i. 繁荣, 茂盛, 活跃, 手舞足蹈；v.t. 挥舞, 夸耀；n. 挥舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 兴旺, 华丽词藻
That might not sound so bad, but earthworms maintain the soil, allowing plants to grow and flourish.
中文语境：这听起来可能没那么糟糕，但蚯蚓可以维持土壤，让植物生长茂盛
exterior /ik'stiəriə/ n. 外部, 表面, 外貌；adj. 外部的, 外在的, 表面的
For example, the bright yellow butterflyfish eats the coral's mucus-like exterior layer.
中文语境：例如，亮黄色蝴蝶鱼吃珊瑚的粘液状外层
far-reaching adj. 深远的, 广泛的, 伸至远处的
Warming temperatures have far-reaching impacts: oceans warm, glaciers melt, sea levels rise, and even the chemistry of the ocean changes.
中文语境：气温变暖具有深远的影响：海洋变暖、冰川融化、海平面上升，甚至海洋的化学成分也发生变化
excess /ik'ses/ n. 过度, 剩于, 超过, 超额；adj. 过量的, 额外的
Each day, the ocean absorbs 22 million tons of excess carbon dioxide made from burning fossil fuels according to Smithsonian .
中文语境：根据史密森学会的数据，海洋每天吸收 2200 万吨因燃烧化石燃料而产生的过量二氧化碳
overcrowd /.əuvə'kraud/ v.t. 容纳过多的人, 使过度拥挤
Instead, people like Elizabeth had to wait for separate, overcrowded "Colored" cars.
中文语境：相反，像伊丽莎白这样的人不得不等待单独的、过度拥挤的"有色人种"汽车
stunning /'stʌniŋ/ adj. 打昏迷的, 弄得人昏头昏脑的, 令人震惊的
In a stunning decision, they found the Third Avenue Railroad Company guilty of all charges.
中文语境：在一项令人震惊的决定中，他们裁定第三大道铁路公司所有指控均成立
hoax /həuks/ v.t. 欺骗, 哄骗, 愚弄；n. 愚弄人, 恶作剧
These famous hoaxes fooled many people. When something sounds too good - or weird - to be true... maybe it isn't. It always pays to check your facts.
中文语境：这些著名的骗局愚弄了很多人。当某件事听起来太好--或者太奇怪--令人难以置信时......也许事实并非如此。检查你的事实总是值得的
bumper /'bʌmpə/ n. 缓冲器, 满杯；adj. 大胜利的
On April Fools' Day in 1957, a British television news show reported that Swiss farmers were enjoying a bumper crop of spaghetti, thanks to the elimination of that dreaded pest, the spaghetti weevil.
中文语境：1957年愚人节，英国电视新闻节目报道称，由于消灭了可怕的害虫--意大利面象鼻虫，瑞士农民迎来了意大利面大丰收
octopus /'ɒktəpəs/ n. 章鱼
Save the Pacific Tree Octopus!
中文语境：拯救太平洋树章鱼！
reveal /ri'viːl/ v.t. 露出, 显示, 透露, 揭露, 泄露, (神)启示；n. 窗侧, 门侧
Then Audubon revealed the fakes and had the last laugh.
中文语境：然后奥杜邦揭露了假货，笑到了最后
paramount /'pærəmaunt/ n. 首长, 最高当局；adj. 最重要的, 最高的, 至上的
The Big Five included Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM), Paramount Pictures, RKO Pictures, Warner Brothers, and 20th Century Fox.
中文语境：五巨头包括米高梅 (MGM)、派拉蒙影业、雷电华影业、华纳兄弟和二十世纪福克斯
frivolous /'frivələs/ adj. 轻佻的, 妄动的, 琐碎的；[法] 轻薄的, 轻浮的, 无意义的
Many Americans' thoughts turned to more frivolous ideas.
中文语境：许多美国人的思想转向了更无聊的想法
comedy /'kɒmidi/ n. 喜剧, 有趣的事情
Together, they listened to broadcasts ranging from comedy and variety shows to news, drama, and sporting events.
中文语境：他们一起收听从喜剧和综艺节目到新闻、戏剧和体育赛事的广播
sketchy /'sketʃi/ adj. 概略的, 草草完成的
Whoa - if you think those last three sound sketchy, you should.
中文语境：哇 - 如果你认为最后三个听起来很粗略，你应该这样做
tripod /'traipɒd/ n. 三脚桌, 三脚架；[医] 三脚架, 三脚台

One of Allain's favorite techniques is to analyze camera shake - you know, the quaking that occurs in a video when the person filming it holds the camera in their hand instead of mounting it on a tripod.
中文语境：阿兰最喜欢的技术之一是分析相机抖动 - 你知道，当拍摄视频的人手持相机而不是将其安装在三脚架上时，视频中会发生震动
sanctum /'sæŋktəm/ n. 圣所, 密室, 私室

While Mamma continued to pray, I silently backed away from Kali and circled the inner sanctum three times while fervently repeating under my breath, "I wish I get Saloni, I wish I get Saloni, I wish I get Saloni..."
中文语境：当妈妈继续祈祷时，我默默地从卡利身边退开，绕着内殿转了三圈，同时低声热切地重复着："我希望我得到萨罗尼，我希望我得到萨罗尼，我希望我得到萨罗尼......"
tepid /'tepid/ adj. 微温的, 温热的, 不太热烈的；[医] 微温的
The summer sun suddenly looked bleak, the sunshine tepid.
中文语境：夏日的阳光突然显得暗淡，阳光不温不火
ablaze /ə'bleiz/ adj. 着火的, 闪亮的, 激昂的；adv. 着火, 闪耀
The dark-skinned, four-armed Kali - her eyes ablaze with fury and her red tongue hanging out - sent little shivers down my spine.
中文语境：深色皮肤、四臂的卡莉--她的眼睛里闪烁着愤怒的光芒，她伸出红色的舌头--让我的脊椎微微颤抖
freckle /'frekl/ n. 雀斑, 斑点；[医] 非曝露部雀斑
Her fair freckled face
中文语境：她那张白皙、有雀斑的脸
bark /bɑːk/ n. 树皮, 吠声；v.i. 吠, 叫骂；v.t. 喊出, 剥树皮
she'd barked
中文语境：她叫了一声
eerie /'iəri/ adj. 怪诞的, 可怕的, 奇异的, 令人迷惑不解的
An eerie unquiet
中文语境：诡异的不安
wreck /rek/ n. 失事, 残骸, 破坏；v.t. 使失事, 拆毁, 破坏；v.i. (船)失事, 营救失事船只
waking a wreck
中文语境：唤醒沉船
wealth /welθ/ n. 财富, 资源, 财产, 丰富, 富裕, 大量；[经] 财富
it held wealth
中文语境：它拥有财富
transformer /træns'fɒːmə/ n. 变压器, 促使变化的人；[化] 变压器
But it's also an amazing transformer.
中文语境：但它也是一个令人惊叹的变压器
knead /niːd/ v.t. 揉, 按摩, 捏；[机] 揉合
As you knead it-stretch it, roll it, and flatten it-the blob soon becomes smooth.
中文语境：当你揉捏它时--拉伸它、滚动它、压平它--斑点很快就会变得光滑
transformation /.trænsfə'meiʃən/ n. 变形, 变质, 变化, 改革, 变换；[化] 转化; 变换
"Baking is one of the most fascinating transformations in cooking," Ross says.
中文语境："烘焙是烹饪中最迷人的转变之一，"罗斯说
adhesive /əd'hiːsiv/ adj. 粘着的, 涂有粘性物质的；n. 粘合剂, 橡皮膏

Sticky tape has been around for more than 80 years. It relies on a special kind of glue. As you push down on a piece of tape, the adhesive on the sticky side seals tightly. But you can easily peel it back off. Some adhesives even come off without leaving anything behind.
中文语境：胶带已经存在了 80 多年。它依赖于一种特殊的胶水。当您按下胶带时，粘性一侧的粘合剂会紧密密封。但您可以轻松地将其剥离。有些粘合剂甚至脱落后没有留下任何东西
hydrocarbon /.haidrəu'kɑːbən/ n. 碳氢化合物；[化] 烃; 碳氢化合物
Companies today use the hydrocarbons that make up this oil for their tape adhesives.
中文语境：如今，许多公司使用这种油中的碳氢化合物来制造胶带粘合剂
soak /səuk/ n. 浸, 湿透, 大雨；v.t. 使上下湿透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉；v.i. 浸泡, 渗透
They soaked their wood in chemicals to break the lignin's long, chain-like molecules into smaller bits.
中文语境：他们将木材浸泡在化学品中，将木质素的长链状分子分解成更小的碎片
additive /'æditiv/ adj. 添加的, 附加的, 加法的, 累积的；n. 添加物
(These chemicals are related to additives that manufacturers sometimes use to make rain gear repel water.)
中文语境：（这些化学物质与制造商有时用来制造雨具防水的添加剂有关。）
millet /'milit/ n. 稷, 粟, 黍；[医] 小米
She wakes up at 4:00 a.m., eats millet porridge, and then walks two miles to her family's cocoa bean field.
中文语境：她凌晨 4:00 起床，吃小米粥，然后步行两英里到她家的可可豆田
ingredient /in'griːdiənt/ n. 成分, 因素；[化] 配合剂; 拼料; 成分; 组分
(Cocoa is the main ingredient in chocolate.) People who buy chocolate are becoming more and more worried about child labor.
中文语境：（可可是巧克力的主要成分。）购买巧克力的人们越来越担心童工问题
eliminate /i'limineit/ v.t. 除去, 排除, 剔除, 消除

The Rainforest Alliance is also working to improve life for farmers, teaching them ways to protect soils, waterways, and wildlife while increasing their yields, ensuring that their children go to school and eliminating child labor.
中文语境：雨林联盟还致力于改善农民的生活，教他们保护土壤、水道和野生动物的方法，同时提高产量，确保他们的孩子上学并消除童工
ensure /in'ʃuə/ v.t. 确定, 保证, 担保, 保护；[经] 确保, 确定

The Rainforest Alliance is also working to improve life for farmers, teaching them ways to protect soils, waterways, and wildlife while increasing their yields, ensuring that their children go to school and eliminating child labor.
中文语境：雨林联盟还致力于改善农民的生活，教他们保护土壤、水道和野生动物的方法，同时提高产量，确保他们的孩子上学并消除童工
disentangle /.disin'tængl/ v.i. 解开纠结, 松开, 解决；v.t. 解开, 松开
As I hurry to disentangle the partially untied bow, the embarrassed girl speaks, and Shiori translates.
中文语境：当我急忙解开部分解开的蝴蝶结时，尴尬的女孩开口说话，诗织负责翻译
sap /sæp/ n. 树液, 体液, 活力, 坑道, 消弱, 警棍；v.t. 使排出体液, 使伤元气, 使衰竭, 挖坑道逼近, 逐渐侵蚀；v.i. 挖坑道, 消弱；[计] 共享汇编程序, 结构分析程序, 符号汇编程序, 服务器广告协议
Disappointment's sapping my morale when Sis whispers, "Chin up.
